gloss: to support financially; to lavish money or gifts on someone

definitions.gloss: to support financially; to lavish money or gifts on someone
definitions.explanation: to give money or expensive gifts to someone, often excessively or one-sidedly, typically motivated by romantic attachment

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貢|みつ}いで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He's spending lavishly on his girlfriend.

examples.japanese: ⟦ホスト→ホスト：25722_hosuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貢|みつ}ぐ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some women lavish money on host club workers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貢|みつ}ぎすぎて⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なくなった。
examples.english: I spent so much on the person I liked that I ran out of savings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{推|お}し→推す：12798_osu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アイドル→アイドル：05111_aidoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{何百万|なんびゃくまん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{貢|みつ}いで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My friend has spent millions of yen on their favorite idol.

notes:
Originally meant to offer tribute or pay taxes to a lord. In modern Japanese, the meaning has shifted to describe lavishing money or gifts on someone, almost always in the context of a one-sided romantic or parasocial relationship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貢|みつ}ぐ: to lavish gifts on one's girlfriend
- ⟦ホスト→ホスト：25722_hosuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貢|みつ}ぐ: to spend lavishly at a host club
- ⟦{推|お}し→推す：12798_osu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貢|みつ}ぐ: to spend money supporting one's favorite celebrity
- {貢|みつ}ぎすぎる: to overspend on someone

CULTURAL NOTE:
The word appears frequently in discussions about the "host/hostess club" industry and idol fan culture, where fans spend large sums to support their favorites. The derived noun {貢|みつ}ぎ{物|もの} means tribute or a gift given to someone of higher status.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おごる→おごる：08157_ogoru⟧: to treat someone to a meal or drink; a normal social act without the negative connotation of {貢|みつ}ぐ
- ⟦{養|やしな}う→養う：04478_yashinau⟧: to support or provide for someone (e.g., a family); implies a legitimate responsibility
